aSeparateCheckEverySecondFrom: A separate check every second from the monitor server itself. It does not affect regular checks, incidents or charts and saves nothing: close the page and the results are gone.
aSeparateCheckEverySecondFromAgent: A separate check every second from the agent “{agent}”, from its network. It does not affect the regular checks, incidents or charts and stores nothing: close the page and the results are gone.
calculatedBetweenSegmentArrivalsSeveralN: Calculated between segment arrivals: several new segments are needed
checksInWhichNewSegmentsAppeared: Checks in which new segments appeared or something was found
clickARowToExpandIt: Click a row to expand it: the calculation and the conclusion for the latest occurrence
everyNewSegmentIsDownloadedIn: Every new segment is downloaded in full — the traffic equals the stream bitrate
howLongThePlaylistHasNot: How long the playlist has not changed
howManyTimesItHappenedAnd: How many times it happened and in how many checks
howMuchVideoAPlayerThat: How much video a player that started watching together with the diagnosis would have left
howMuchVideoAppearsInThe: How much video appears in the playlist per second of real time. Below 100 % the player will stall sooner or later
interruptedConnectionToTheServerLost: Interrupted: connection to the server lost
kindsOfFailure: kind of failure | kinds of failure
kindsOfWarning: kind of warning | kinds of warning
nothingNewSoFarThePlaylist: Nothing new so far: the playlist has not changed
nothingSoFarAllChecksPassed: Nothing so far: all checks passed without problems
numberOfTheFirstSegmentIn: Number of the first segment in the playlist and how many segments it has
playlistsAndTheFirstKilobytesOf: Playlists and the first kilobytes of every new segment
playlistsOnlyAlmostNoTrafficBut: Playlists only: almost no traffic, but the video arrival rate and the segments themselves are not checked
segmentsCheckedAndHowManyOf: Segments checked and how many of them failed to download
timeToFirstByteAndTotal: Time to first byte and total request time
vantageHint: The diagnosis is made by the server itself or by the agent chosen, from where it stands in the network
whetherTheSegmentStartsWithA: Whether the segment starts with a keyframe
wholeSegmentsAndParsingOfTheir: Whole segments and parsing of their contents: tracks, timestamps, MPEG-TS errors
endAgentNotTaking: the agent is not taking requests: it is out of contact or busy
endAgentTooOld: the agent is too old for this
endAgentUnreadable: the agent sent something that cannot be read
